plan.primary_bottleneck: Linear O(N) membership scan across a Python list (seen_utrs) for every transaction record, yielding O(N^2) total deduplication time coupled with repeated Decimal object instantiations and nested dictionary lookups.
hidden_invariants: Idempotent first-seen-wins UTR deduplication: duplicate UTRs increment duplicate_count and are skipped completely without affecting merchant ledgers or RBI flags.

REVERSAL transactions increment txn_count and subtract gross_paise from both gross_paise and net_payout_paise with 0 MDR, 0 GST, and strictly bypass RBI high-value flagging even if amount_paise >= 5,000,000.

RBI zero-MDR mandate: non-REVERSAL UPI transactions with amount_paise <= 200,000 incur 0 MDR and 0 GST; UPI > 200,000 and all CARD/NETBANKING transactions apply 45 bps for ENTERPRISE tier and 85 bps for all other tiers.

Exact integer-paise ROUND_HALF_UP arithmetic: MDR is rounded half-up to the nearest integer paise before computing 18% GST, which is also rounded half-up independently; net_payout_paise = gross_paise - mdr_paise - gst_paise.

RBI compliance flagging and canonical digest parity: only non-duplicate, non-REVERSAL transactions with gross_paise >= 5,000,000 are appended to rbi_flagged_utrs, and the SHA-256 parity digest requires sorted merchant keys, sorted rbi_flagged_utrs, and compact JSON separators (',', ':').
plan.modernization_strategy: Replace the O(N) list scan with an O(1) hash-set lookup for UTR deduplication, replace slow Decimal instantiations with exact integer-math half-up rounding ((val * num + den // 2) // den), aggregate merchant ledgers via local dataclass/slots or vectorized Polars/PyArrow structures, and verify bit-exact SHA-256 digest parity against unmodified golden batch tests via Antigravity /teamwork falsifiers.
plan.target_gcp_runtime: Cloud Run Jobs (for containerized batch execution up to millions of rows) or Google Cloud Dataflow (Apache Beam) for horizontally scaled streaming/massive-batch UPI settlement.
